headline.zh-CN: 评审波形支持精细缩放与定位
headline.en: Review waveforms now support precise zooming and navigation

summary.zh-CN: 评审者现在可以放大波形后精确创建时间点与时间段标记，并在当前倍率下快速定位已有问题。
summary.en: Reviewers can now zoom into waveforms for precise point and range annotations, then locate existing issues without losing their current zoom level.

description.zh-CN: 完整评审波形新增分级缩放、适应全曲、滚轮浏览和拖拽平移。点标记、范围标记、草稿标记与 A/B 对比波形会跟随同一时间轴同步移动。
description.en: Full review waveforms now include stepped zoom, fit-to-track, wheel navigation, and drag panning. Point markers, range markers, draft annotations, and A/B comparison waveforms stay aligned to the same timeline.

title.zh-CN: 已有问题保持倍率定位

description.zh-CN: 点击已有问题或波形标记时，波形会在当前倍率下将对应位置移动到视野中央，不会自动改变缩放比例。
description.en: Selecting an existing issue or waveform marker centers its location at the current zoom level without changing the selected zoom ratio.

description.zh-CN: 批准源音频补交或重新开启流程后，曲目详情仍会显示此前轮次的问题记录；当前波形只显示与当前音频对应的标记。
description.en: After a source follow-up is approved or a workflow is reopened, track details continue to show issues from earlier cycles while the current waveform only displays markers for the active audio.
